title: UI风格#121 - Glitch Noir (故障黑色电影)
description: 创建第121种UI风格：故障黑色电影风格 - 数字故障与黑色电影结合、赛博朋克侦探。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planDQ.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Glitch Noir style When color palette Then features deep black, neon pink, static white, surveillance green
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#0D0D0D (深黑), #FF1493 (霓虹粉), #FFFFFF (静态白), #00FF00 (监控绿), #4B0082 (靛蓝)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Glitch Noir style When typography Then uses corrupted tech: Share Tech Mono, VT323, or Roboto Mono
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Share Tech Mono (显示), VT323 (正文), Roboto Mono (替代)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Glitch Noir style When layout Then corrupted frames, static bursts, surveillance monitors, rain streaks
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：损坏帧、静电爆发、监控显示器、雨条纹

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Glitch Noir style When UI elements Then RGB split, scan lines, static noise, glitch corruption
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：RGB分离、扫描线、静电噪声、故障腐败

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Glitch Noir UI When functional Then includes hacker chat, operative agents, encrypted stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：黑客聊天、特工代理、加密统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Glitch Noir UI When copy Then uses cyber noir: 'Access', 'Decrypt', 'Trace', 'Terminate'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'ACCESS. DECRYPT. TRACE.'、按钮'SEND'→'HACK'、'SUBMIT'→'BREACH'
